name: print-social-triangle-tile-and-echo-blur-poster-pair
title: Two posters: yellow-orange triangle tessellation over DON'T KNOW, and a blue echo-trail letter form
whatItIs: Two posters on black. The left cream poster has a yellow and orange triangle pattern above two columns of small text and a heavy black 'DON'T KNOW'. The right white poster shows huge blue letters echoed in shifting blue tints, with small blue text blocks.
whatItMeans: Uncertain and playful; the pattern and the echo effect illustrate doubt and blur.
techniques: Tile triangles in two warm colours.
Repeat letters with offset tints to create motion echo.
Use tiny two-column text as texture.
Stay in a limited palette per poster.

vocabulary.definition: A pattern of triangles filling a rectangle.
Repeated shapes offset and shaded to imply motion.
A word set very bold across two lines.
Small text columns used as texture.
